description.value: Merci Boulangerie is a French-inspired artisan bakery on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, founded by Red Seal Baker Natalie Cumberbirch, who trained at the two-Michelin-star L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon in Paris and the celebrated boulangerie Mamiche. The shop serves freshly baked croissants, pastries, and bread alongside coffee and locally curated retail items. For touring cyclists riding Commercial Drive, it is a well-located stop for high-quality baked goods in one of Vancouver's most vibrant neighbourhood corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 52m; stands (6 spaces) at 92m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is clearly active (© 2026 footer, delivery slots dated June 2026, OSM check_date 2026-05-18), confirming the business is open. The website corroborates the OSM phone number (778-875-1424 cited on the delivery page) and address (2879 Commercial Drive Vancouver, BC V5N 0A6). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears on the site or in OSM tags beyond wheelchair=yes.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists only Fr, Sa, Su but the website explicitly lists Thursday retail hours (7:30am–2pm); OSM hours appear incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating artisan bakery confirmed open as of May 2026 on a busy Vancouver cycling corridor.
